text:
maria: deploybot just flagged a latency bump in the new release, traffic at 20% :rotating_light:
deploybot: Deploy started; traffic slice=20%; metrics: p95_latency +42% vs baseline; error_rate +0.8%; monitor tag=release/2026-03-23
ops-oncall: @maria can you paste the p95 window? looking at traces now :eyes:
ajay: I see increased tail on transcoder calls, spikes concentrated in eu-west1. Could be kernel flag mismatch.
maria: agree. rollout policy set to auto-fallback but deploybot didn't trigger auto-revert yet. ops, what's our auto-revert threshold?
ops-oncall: auto-revert = p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR error_rate > 1% for 3m. We're at 1.42x p95 and 0.95% errors at 6m. borderline.
ben: leaning manual rollback. We don't want customers seeing repeated 502s. Also release notes mention streaming fixes; this could impact sessions.
iris: manual rollback checklist: 1) notify customers if >5% traffic impacted 2) run rollback command 3) pin older model + drain. Drafted a quick customer blurb below.
ethan: +1 to manual rollback. Ops has bandwidth to execute now (nightshift).
maria: ok calling it. manual rollback executed in 2 steps: step A pin variant to v2026-03-18, step B drain new pods. running commands now.
ops-oncall: running: ```
# rollback to previous stable tag
redwoodctl rollout set --service inference --tag stable-2026-03-18 --traffic 100
redwoodctl drain --selector release=2026-03-23 --timeout 300
```
deploybot: Rollout command acknowledged. Traffic shift started -> 100% stable-2026-03-18. ETA ~35s.
maria: monitoring... p95 back to baseline, error_rate dropping. good. sending customer comms draft.
iris: customer draft: "We're rolling back tonight to address a latency regression in the latest release. No action required on your side, service is stable. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." Thoughts?
ajay: short and clear. add ETA for follow-up: "expect update within 24 hours".
ben: also add contact for urgent issues: support@redwood.ai or reply here.
maria: sent comms to customers in impacted orgs. logging rollback as manual-exit due to latency-regression in release notes.
ops-oncall: post-rollback tasks: capture kdump and traces, snapshot infra metrics, and tag the deploy for rollback analysis. I'll create an issue.
ethan: adding: prioritize reproducer on eu-west1 with seq_len=512. assign to eng-runtime.
maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene in 1h for triage. :thumbsup:
